coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Comb cells and squares found in the embedded pictures at their own resolution (picfields.py, imgsq.py) and grouped into fields by row, gap and caption position; text-layer rules and "¨" box characters from pdfplumber; every form page looked at; overlays looked at.
